6. 字段错误时 `errors[]` **始终返回**（不限于多项），`error` 仍为首项，前端统一逐字段渲染。

另有两项供 #3 注意（不影响其他模块）：空字段文案采用 `<Field> is required` 约定；`/password-reset` 与 `/settings/*` 目前是占位页，由 #3 替换。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Platform-path check: install/build/start exactly as the delivery platform does,
# then run the Playwright suite against that process.
#
#   bash checks/platform-path.sh
#
# The runner owns its services (e2e/run.mjs starts and stops the backend) and uses
# a throwaway SQLite database, so it does not touch the application's data.
# Run it from a clean copy of the repository to mirror the platform's fresh
# checkout; it never needs a root `pnpm install`.
set -euo pipefail

export PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$repo_root"

echo "== platform toolchain =="
/usr/local/bin/node --version
/usr/local/bin/npm --version

if [ ! -x node_modules/.bin/playwright ]; then
  echo "== root tooling: npm install (Playwright runner only) =="
  npm install --no-audit --no-fund
fi

echo "== frontend: npm install && npm run build =="
(cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build)

echo "== backend: npm install =="
(cd backend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund)

echo "== backend: npm run start (via e2e runner) + Playwright =="
node e2e/run.mjs --no-build --server "npm run start" --server-cwd backend

echo "== platform check finished =="
